senses.gloss: (נְגַד; cmp. מִשְׁכָא) leather-strap, lash; trnsf. lashing, punishment.
units: Yoma 23ᵃ פקיע נ׳ (Ms. M. מַדְרָא) p’ḳi‘a (Shek. V, 1) means lashing.

<cite ref="Pesachim 52a">Pes. 52ᵃ</cite> <he>ממנין אני׳ וכ׳</he> (not <he>ממינן</he>; Rashi a. Ms. O. <he>אנוּ׳</he>; Ms. M. <he>ממנו אנַגּוּדָא</he>) a vote must be taken on the lashing of a scholar; <cite ref="Pesachim 52a:3">ib.</cite> <he>אנַגַּדְתָּא</he>.
<cite ref="Shevuot 41a:8">Shebu. 41ᵃ</cite> <he>עד דמטי זמן נִגְדֵּיה</he> until the time comes when he is to be lashed (for not heeding the excommunication).
